questions.text: Explain the differences between the democratic system of government and the Dictatorial government.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the differences between the democratic system of government and the Dictatorial government. (Difficult)

answer.value:
The following are some of the differences between the democratic system of government in which I live and the dictatorship system of government.
Democratic Government: 1. The government is run through representatives elected by the people. 2. With the support of the people, the people themselves are the sovereigns and govern the administration. 3. In a democracy, individuals enjoy personal freedom, freedom of expression, and the freedom to establish associations and organizations.
Authoritarian Government: 1. The entire power of the State is concentrated in one person or a small group. 2. The opinion of a single person or a single group, without any restrictions, is supreme, and the dictator can govern according to his own wishes; the people do not have any freedom and therefore do not have the right to question or oppose the government.
